topStories.headline: Trump Reimposing Strait of Hormuz Blockade; 20% Levy on All Cargo Effective 4 p.m. ET Today
topStories.summary: President Trump announced the US will reinstate its blockade of the Strait of Hormuz starting 4 p.m. ET today, with a 20% fee charged on all cargo passing through the waterway that handles roughly 20% of global oil and gas trade — escalating the US-Iran standoff that began in February.
topStories.marketImpact: Oil ↑ sharply (WTI +8% to ~$78/bbl, Brent near $83); energy stocks XOM, CVX ↑; airlines and global shipping ↓; inflation re-acceleration risk watch

topStories.headline: Five Major US Banks Report Q2 Earnings Before Open; Investment Banking Bonanza Anticipated
topStories.summary: JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, and Citigroup all report Q2 2026 results this morning, with analysts broadly expecting double-digit EPS growth powered by surging trading revenues (+14% YoY) and investment banking fees boosted by the record SpaceX IPO.
topStories.marketImpact: JPM, GS, BAC, WFC, C ↑ on anticipated beats; focus on net interest margin guidance and any management caution around the Iran-driven macro outlook

topStories.headline: June CPI Released at 8:30 a.m. ET; Inflation Expected to Ease to ~3.9% as Gasoline Prices Drop
topStories.summary: The BLS releases June CPI data today; consensus expects the headline rate to fall from 4.2% in May to ~3.8–3.9% year-over-year, driven by a ~10% decline in gasoline prices during June — a partial reversal of three consecutive monthly accelerations caused by the Iran energy shock.
topStories.marketImpact: Bonds ↑ (TLT) if data confirms disinflation; USD ↓; equities may get a relief bounce; an upside CPI surprise would rattle rate-cut expectations and weigh on risk assets

topStories.headline: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh Delivers Inaugural Congressional Testimony at 10 a.m. ET
topStories.summary: Newly installed Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh gives his first semiannual monetary policy address before the House Financial Services Committee today — coinciding with the June CPI print — with the Senate Banking Committee appearance following tomorrow.
topStories.marketImpact: Hawkish Warsh tone would push yields ↑ and equities ↓; any opening to rate cuts would spark a bond rally; his personal Bitcoin holdings and anti-inflation track record expected to draw lawmaker scrutiny

topStories.headline: Nikkei Falls 1.92%; Yaskawa Crashes 14%, Kioxia Sheds 13% on Disappointing Results
topStories.summary: Japan's Nikkei 225 closed down 1.92% on Monday as the oil-price surge darkened Japan's corporate outlook; robot maker Yaskawa Electric plunged 14.34% after Q1 net profit fell 21.7%, while memory chip maker Kioxia shed 12.86% on weak guidance.
topStories.marketImpact: 6506.T ↓, 285A.T ↓; Japanese manufacturers face margin pressure as energy import costs rise; Nikkei futures point to further weakness Tuesday

topStories.headline: Japanese Bank Stocks Rally as Investors Rotate From AI Tech Into Value
topStories.summary: Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group rose 2.31% and Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group gained 1.63% on Monday as investors shifted out of AI-related growth names into value stocks, limiting the broader Topix's decline to just 0.71% versus the Nikkei's 1.92% fall.
topStories.marketImpact: 8306.T ↑, 8316.T ↑; rotation trade signals caution on Japan's high-multiple tech sector; Japanese financial stocks benefiting from higher interest rate environment

topStories.headline: DeepSeek Developing Own AI Inference Chip, Deepening China's Semiconductor Independence Push
topStories.summary: Chinese AI startup DeepSeek is building a proprietary chip optimised for AI inference, the latest move by a major Chinese tech firm to reduce dependence on US-controlled semiconductor supply chains as domestic chipmakers' market share is projected to reach 55% by 2027.
topStories.marketImpact: NVDA ↓ watch (long-term China market risk elevated); domestic Chinese chip ecosystem ↑; Huawei and SMIC beneficiaries as US firms lose ground in world's largest AI market

topStories.headline: China June Exports Beat at +5.8% YoY; Imports Return to Growth for First Time in 2026
topStories.summary: China's June trade data released today showed exports grew 5.8% year-over-year — beating the 5% consensus — with ASEAN shipments surging 16.8% and EU up 7.6%; imports rose 1.1% for the first growth reading of the year, signalling tentative domestic demand recovery.
topStories.marketImpact: 9988.HK, 0700.HK ↑ on improved China growth outlook; rare earth exports hit a record (+60.3%) — a strategic lever for Beijing; US exports fell 16.1% for a third month but rate of decline eased

topStories.headline: Zhipu AI Launches $4 Billion Hong Kong Share Sale After Stock Surged 1,500%
topStories.summary: Beijing-based AI firm Zhipu AI launched an accelerated $4 billion share placement in Hong Kong at HK$1,588–1,698 per share — a 7–13% discount to its July 8 close — after the stock surged ~1,500% since its January HKEX IPO, with proceeds earmarked for R&D and computing infrastructure.
topStories.marketImpact: Tests investor appetite for Chinese AI at elevated valuations; HK IPO market remains active after Luxshare Precision's record HK$24.3B debut last week; Hong Kong AI tech sentiment bullish

topStories.headline: South Korea KOSPI Drops 5.14%, Leads Asia-Wide Sell-Off on Oil Surge and Semiconductor Weakness
topStories.summary: Asian markets broadly declined on Monday, with South Korea's KOSPI suffering the steepest losses as semiconductor and AI stocks plunged amid renewed Middle East tensions, the sharp rise in oil prices, and investor caution ahead of today's US inflation print.
topStories.marketImpact: 005930.KS ↓, 000660.KS ↓; pan-Asia tech and semis under broad pressure; MSCI Asia ex-Japan declining; oil-importing Asian economies face currency and inflation headwinds

companiesToWatch.name: Yaskawa Electric
